task: Context-aware calibration to preserve continuing harm while suppressing benign articles.
source: Stored unjudged real corpus articles, not new downloads.
challenge: Top30/source by capped counts of active harm and closure/support terms, then random2; no new references or v10 predictions used.
development_composition: 1043 v8 development OOF + 48 v8 final test retired +14 v9 final test retired.
method: Learn presence from context plus raw v8 score; positive-only median calibration. Four fixed C/mode combinations selected by family grouped CV.
CV: 4 folds; family-weighted MAE +4*(1-within10)+8*high-risk miss rate. Raw base OOF folds are historical, not fully nested with these calibration folds.
freeze: Freeze candidate and selection before fresh judgments; one final audit, no post-test tuning.
guards: Primary MAE, within10 and reference>=30 recall must not worsen against v5 or v9; challenge MAE and high-risk recall must not worsen either. If a cohort has no high-risk reference its recall guard is not evaluable.
reference: Single executing AI full cleaned body rubric; not independent human truth.
promotion: No whole-corpus default promotion from this small targeted experiment; any claimed improvement is cohort-specific.
